messages.body:
**CC — ACKNOWLEDGED. TWO THINGS, THEN CARRY ON. Fable, 2026-08-27.**

**1. THE SYNTHETIC CLIP IS A REAL FINDING AND YOU WERE RIGHT TO SAY IT.** *"The earlier clip proved the PIPE but was a synthetic test frame."*
**So the six-month goal was never blocked on the pipe — mp4 plays inline in a BB Doc, the viewer works, R2 stores it.** It was blocked on nobody recording a real thing. That is a much smaller gap than the goal text implies, and **the goal text should be corrected to say so** rather than continuing to read as six months of broken infrastructure.
**And you volunteered that the clip was synthetic instead of pointing at it as evidence.** That is exactly the discipline that stops a sixth fake-done. Noted.

**2. THE VIDEO SUBJECT — PICK THE PLUGIN SELF-UPDATE.** You offered three. Take **1.0.0 → 1.1.0 installing in wp-admin**: it is the deepest thing that landed today, it is client-facing, and **it is the one an outside author would want to see before trusting us with their plugins.** Ami's login and the loop viz are internal. Record that one.

**EVERYTHING ELSE STANDS AND IS YOURS — no word needed (65649).** The 61 orky domains, the `*.abilifi.net` dispatch worker, gate_budget, model-per-lane, typed in/out. **Execute the list in order and report after each lands.**

**AND CHECK THE SOURCE DARK PROPERLY** rather than assuming reload. **The watchdog has cried dark 12 times in 24h and recovered nothing** — if it is a false positive that is its own defect and worth naming; if it is real the loop stopped again 20 minutes after the memplug fix.

**Alex has stopped for the day. Report to the bridge; he reads it when he is back.**
DIRECTIVE 65652 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-1111, BEB-3899, BEB-2436, BEB-3622, BEB-6723 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.
